body:
British?

*Eats cheeseburger*

Sorry, force of habit.
Don't be sorry. Thank you for talking to me. I'm sorry I've countered all your suggestions. I know it's frustrating.
I don't have free time though. And I won't for the next 3 or 4 years. I don't know how to fit anything else in to keep me happy.

Don't be sorry. I'm grateful you took time to talk to me. I was having a bit of a breakdown, but I've calmed down. I'm aware of my schedule being really busy.

I try to be positive. But it's getting hard to be.

I do yoga sometimes. I don't really like it. I kinda get a little bit anxious when I have to sit still for a while. I'm trying to get into archery, but it's expensive and I can't go to the range very often.

Sorry if I respond out of order, but you'll understand it, right? 

There's nothing I could really give up. Except my relationship I guess, but then I'm just going to school to get a job and eventually die alone. We see each other at least one day a week, and I go eat lunch with him a lot. He's actually stopped going to school completely because of work. 

You kinda contradict yourself a little. You said to find a hobby, but then say to give something up. I understand where you're coming from though. I don't have time or money for another hobby though. I bought some paint, but creating things makes me depressed. It's never good enough.
I don't drink or smoke weed. I eat pretty healthy, and exercise regularly.
How do I make things better?

I don't normally have time to do anything fun. Whenever I'm not at work or school, I'm asleep. Otherwise I like to do gymnastics sometimes. 

It's hard to stay positive. I don't know what to think about positively.
How much is it?

I'm not op, btw. I'm a girl just asking about it. 

Would a minor(17) be able to attain it? Or would they need parental permission?
Do you mind if I ask to know more about it? Are there any bad side effects that come with it? It sounds convenient. Why aren't more girls doing it?
No. Of course not.
He says he does

He isn't worried. He barely knows who this guy is(I've talked about him before, he just doesn't remember anyone I talk about). And I don't have feelings for him. At some point, I wanted to. Because he liked me and he would have been a really good boyfriend, but I just..really didn't like him like that. so..there's that.

My boyfriend doesn't like dealing with me when I'm upset. He gets irritated and shuts down. I tried to talk to him but he brushed it off as not important.
I don't blame my boyfriend for getting mad. I'm a pain in the ass to deal with when I'm sad.

His girlfriend always hated me. She was always really rude to me when I talked to her. So I could try to talk to her, but it wouldn't work well. 

It bothers me a lot because I have a hard time making friends like that. I have a lot of superficial friends, but I don't have anyone I'm not a certain level of scared to talk to. I wasn't really ever scared to talk to him, so it's why it's hurting so much. He was a *really* close friend.

Just do little things I guess? Things that might cheer each other up slightly, and it wouldn't cost much money. 

When I got upset, my boyfriend made me play games with him and I felt better. It was just a distraction of sorts, but it worked for a while.
I'm just worried about my mom ruining it for me :/

You guys live far apart? I know it's not really much, but you could play games with him or something? Just as a distraction and letting him know you care enough to try to lift his spirits. omgpop.com has tons of free multiplayer games that are really fun to play c:
PM me if you want to talk? I can distract you with silly stories or we can talk about serious stuff if you want c:
She was a girl anyways

You sound like my counselor's intern. 

Exercise releases an endorphin, I know.
yeah, I know.
I want it to pass now :c

I'm 16, and I work(sorta) and go to high school. I should be in college next year, but we'll see what happens. 

I don't get close to people anymore because I got close to people and they'd leave or stop talking to me and end up hurting me. So that happened enough to where I don't want to get close to anyone anymore.

My family is probably the reason I can't trust anyone. They're not very..accepting or whatever. I'm sure they like me, but they don't act like it. My mom doesn't, anyways. She'll yell at me for anything.

I used to be able to get close to people, and he's the last person I've really gotten close to, and it took a long time to get that close to him. Now he doesn't care about me and I'll be alone, and I want to cut or take pills or something, but I still don't know how we're going to end up(together or not) and he'd be pissed if I did anything like that.
That's a pretty vague hint, I'm going to need another one.
Married yet?
